format: append-only JSONL monitoring events; not C2 Evidence

identity.parent_id: telemetry epoch + per-store UUID + monotonic dispatch ordinal; independent of optional evidence_parent_id
identity.original_dispatch_identity: session, original spool sequence, exact ordered spool_ids
identity.epoch: explicit monitor epoch; must match Evidence epoch when enabled

fields.row_count: original dispatched input rows including duplicates; not changed count nor cache total
fields.parent_bytes: sum original spool file bytes; null for direct input without measured bytes
fields.finished_at: save-result or later Evidence terminal observation UTC wall time; null when missing
fields.rows_observed: prefix observed by telemetry before stop; includes comparison-failure row
fields.duplicate_count: semantic duplicate count in known prefix
fields.transport_only_count: subset of duplicate; transport fields differ
fields.capture_completed: true only if all rows classified and observation/evidence capture not stopped
fields.capture_stopped_at_ordinal: zero-based first stop/failure position; null on complete
fields.capture_stop_reason: Evidence stop, monitoring budget, classification bound or error
fields.unknown_remaining: true if incomplete; no imputation of missing suffix
fields.cache_write_started_at: wall clock immediately before original cache write; null if no write
fields.cache_write_finished_at: wall clock after successful original cache write; null if failed/no write
fields.cache_write_duration_ms: monotonic duration original write; not full save or commit latency
fields.ack_at: owning spool host receives matching original ACK, before cleanup
fields.ack_latency_ms: monotonic dispatch-to-matched-host-ACK, includes IPC/worker queue/merge/write; never commit latency
fields.dispatch_evidence_mode: OFF/ON configured at dispatch, immutable comparison cohort; ON includes later blocked/bypassed
fields.evidence_capture_duration_ms: measured existing observe+seal calls only, distinct from observation_duration_ms
fields.observation_duration_ms: known count observer measured cost; cooperative budget, no preemption guarantee
fields.evidence_continuity: GAP/CONTINUITY_UNKNOWN for stopped/failed; otherwise no continuity claim

durability: background OS append, no per-parent fsync; abrupt termination/torn tail is monitor gap; external status must be included in acceptance
summary: nearest-rank p=ceil(n*p)-1; n=0 gives null; parent n from DISPATCH once per identity; full and partial counts separate; missing terminal/end marker/sequence flags monitor_gap
prohibitions: No Evidence contract or core changes
